# v0.4.2 — The scan now finishes with a moment instead of a stop

Scans used to end abruptly — the spinner stopped and every number snapped
into place at once. Completion is now a small reveal:

- **The ring pulses** once with a cyan glow as the spinning stops
- **The total counts up from zero** — it stays at "0 B" during the scan so
  the final reclaimable size lands as the finale, rolling with an
  ease-out over ~900 ms
- **"View results" glows** the moment it becomes usable, drawing the eye
  to the next step

Cancelled scans do not animate, empty scans only update the number, and
reduced-motion preferences skip both the count-up and the CSS pulses.
